result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major text truncation problem and a minor layout overflow issue affecting visibility.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section. The full name is likely longer but is being cut off by the card container.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card width or use text ellipsis with proper overflow handling to ensure full restaurant names are visible or properly indicated as truncated with an ellipsis ('...')

issues.description: The category filter row on the right side shows a partially cut-off category button beyond 'Healthy', indicating horizontal scroll content that isn't fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all filter buttons are fully visible within the viewport, or provide a clear visual indicator (like a scroll arrow or gradient fade) to show there are more categories available
